purpose: Stable Atlas v1.5 consumer contract for Malkom Domain Warehouse consumption without making Malkom the owner of canonical domain truth.

governance.historical_fixture: Road LTL 1.2 -> Domain Warehouse 2.3 -> Malkom 3.0 is reference-only, not current-lineage proof

consumption.note: Current Malkom file/package/API/schema interface is not evidenced in ATL-138 authoritative inputs; downstream ATL-139/169 must bind only when evidence exists.

requirements.evidence_test: ATL-139 must prove every emitted concept resolves to current Atlas lineage; no consumer-authored canonical IDs

requirements.atlas_source: Atlas canonical work model where present
requirements.projection_rule: project governed work semantics without changing canonical ownership
requirements.evidence_test: round-trip ID and lineage test; missing semantics fail closed

requirements.requirement: Rules, validations and contextual knowledge required by execution
requirements.projection_rule: emit consumer projection with source IDs and version/provenance
requirements.evidence_test: projection contains source identity and evidence pointer; Malkom does not recreate domain rule truth

requirements.atlas_source: client binding layer, not reusable canonical domain truth
requirements.canonical_id_rule: canonical semantic ID + client binding identity
requirements.projection_rule: bind only from evidenced authorized client binding
requirements.evidence_test: absence of client binding produces explicit fail-closed state, never inferred value

requirements.canonical_id_rule: reference canonical semantic ID where applicable
requirements.projection_rule: do not store transaction value as Atlas reusable domain truth
requirements.evidence_test: contract/package contains schema/semantic requirement only, not fabricated runtime values

requirements.requirement: Current Malkom ingestion interface and exact field/schema expectations
requirements.projection_rule: bind adapter only after interface evidence is obtained
requirements.evidence_test: ATL-139/169 must not claim executable adapter compatibility until interface evidence is linked

requirements.atlas_source: Atlas versioned canonical assets and source registry
requirements.projection_rule: emit contract_version, source_version, provenance/evidence refs and deterministic package identity
requirements.evidence_test: same governed inputs reproduce same logical projection and lineage is inspectable

requirements.projection_rule: emit unresolved/unsupported/binding-required disposition rather than silently dropping
requirements.evidence_test: every material requirement has explicit disposition and loss state

requirements.requirement: Authorized user inspection and product UX consumption
requirements.projection_rule: ATL-140/167 consume structured rows for status, lineage, evidence and residual display
requirements.evidence_test: UI/product path queries contract data; documentation-only rendering is insufficient

requirements.canonical_id_rule: Atlas IDs remain stable independent of Malkom labels/schema
requirements.projection_rule: consumer adapter maps from Atlas IDs; never redefine Atlas canonical model around Malkom-specific field names
requirements.evidence_test: a second consumer can project from same canonical IDs without Malkom dependency

malkom_must_not_recreate: canonical domain concept definitions and IDs
canonical work/work-definition semantics already governed by Atlas
governed reusable domain rules/validations/context where Atlas supplies them

downstream_contract.ATL_139: generate current-lineage package only from evidenced/projectable rows and preserve explicit residual states
downstream_contract.ATL_169: prove projection boundary, adapter/interface evidence and handoff without shifting canonical ownership to Malkom
downstream_contract.ATL_140_ATL_167: make requirements/dispositions/lineage/evidence inspectable and consumable in product interaction
downstream_contract.ATL_173: prove Malkom utility separately from consumer independence
